items.title: iPadOS Gets Native Zelda: Ocarina of Time Port Via AI
items.excerpt: AI-assisted decompilation/recompilation has produced a native iPadOS port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, freeing the classic from N64 frame-rate caps and low-resolution constraints. A concrete example of generative/AI tooling reshaping game porting and preservation workflows — turning a months-long reverse-engineering effort into a far faster pipeline.

items.title: Half of all games released on Steam will use AI by 2028, study predicts: 'AI lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several'
items.excerpt: A new study projects that roughly half of games released on Steam will use AI by 2028, arguing 'AI lowers the barrier not just to make a game but to make several.' A data point on how generative tooling is reshaping the economics and volume of game-making — and what that means for designers competing for discoverability.
